description: This is the HTML documentation page for the PHP class Opencart\System\Library\Session, describing its purpose, location, and methods.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Session
classes.description: Represents a session handler in the OpenCart system, providing methods to start, close, destroy, and manage session data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Session object with a specified adaptor and registry.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a session and returns the session ID.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Writes session data to storage and closes the session.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the current session from storage.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection on old sessions.
